sections.title: Time, Velocity, and Speed
learning_objectives: Define average velocity and average speed, and compute them from a motion diagram.

misconception.text: Average velocity tells you how fast an object is moving at this moment.

correction.text: It covers the whole journey. The speed at a moment is the instantaneous speed.

signal.text: Our own question offers the instantaneous reading as an option.

stem.text: A car covers 100 km in 2 hours and its average speed is 50 km/h. It returns over the same road in another 2 hours. What is its average velocity for the round trip?

explanation.text: The displacement over the round trip is zero, so the average velocity is zero, even though the average speed is 50 km/h.
